title: IAR (International and Alumni Relations)
summary: Alumni and corporate relations, Chennai36, IITM TV, Heritage Club, Global Engagement Council.

posts.md:
The **International & Alumni Relations (IAR) Secretary** represents IIT Madras beyond the campus by strengthening alumni engagement, corporate partnerships, institute branding, and international collaborations.

The IAR Student Council works closely with the **Office of Alumni & Corporate Relations (ACR)**, the **Office of Global Engagement (OGE)**, and the **Heritage Centre** to connect students with alumni, industry, and universities across the world.

This guide provides an overview of the student bodies that function under the IAR Secretary.

## Contents

Alumni & Corporate Relations Council (ACRC)

Branding Council

Global Engagement Council (GEC)

## Alumni & Corporate Relations Council (ACRC)

The Alumni & Corporate Relations Council connects students with alumni, industry leaders, and corporate partners.

## Alumni Relations Cell (ARC)

ARC strengthens the relationship between students, alumni, and the IIT Madras Alumni Association (IITMAA).

### Activities

- Alumni mentoring

- Career guidance

- Networking opportunities

- Knowledge-sharing sessions

### Flagship Events

Leader Lecture Series (LLS)

Alumni Reunions

## Corporate Relations Cell (CRC)

CRC builds partnerships with companies while creating opportunities and benefits for students.

### Activities

- Corporate sponsorships

- Industry partnerships

- Student affinity programs

- Corporate networking

- Saarthi Fund (student emergency medical assistance)

### Flagship Events

Net-Vest

Industry Day

## Branding Council

The Branding Council showcases IIT Madras to students, alumni, industry, and the global community through writing, media, design, and storytelling.

## Chennai36 (C36)

The institute's official student writing platform.

### Activities

- Student stories

- Alumni interviews

- Startup features

- Research highlights

- Campus Times

- Institute Yearbook

## Institute Branding Cell (IBC)

Promotes IIT Madras through branding campaigns and outreach initiatives.

### Flagship Initiatives

A Day @ IITM

Sawera

Parents Day

Institute Mascot

Branding Conclave

IITM Gift Shop

## IITM TV

The official student media and video production team.

### Activities

- Campus videos

- Event coverage

- Filmmaking workshops

- Editing & cinematography

- Creative productions

## Branding Council (Continued)

## Heritage Club

Preserves and promotes the history and legacy of IIT Madras.

### Activities

- Heritage walks

- Historical exhibitions

- Alumni interactions

- Heritage workshops

## Design & WebOps

Provides the creative and technical support for all IAR initiatives.

### Responsibilities

- Posters & banners

- Branding assets

- Event graphics

- Registration portals

- IAR website

- Chennai36 website

- Event landing pages

## Global Engagement Council (GEC)

The Global Engagement Council promotes international collaborations, exchange opportunities, and multicultural experiences at IIT Madras.

## Opportunities & Outreach Team (OOT)

Helps students explore academic and research opportunities around the world.

### Activities

- Semester exchange guidance

- International internships

- Research opportunities

- Conference opportunities

- Exchange Bluebooks

- Information sessions

## World Culture Team (WCT)

Creates a welcoming environment for international students while celebrating cultural diversity on campus.

### Activities

- Language Cafés

- Global Cuisine Workshops

- Foreign Film Screenings

- Cultural exchange events

- Support for exchange students

## Global Engagement Council (Continued)

## Events & Publicity Team

Promotes international opportunities and organizes events connecting IIT Madras with partner universities worldwide.

### Flagship Event

International Day

### Activities

- International outreach

- Exchange programme promotion

- Event management

- Publicity campaigns

**Did you know?**

Whether you're looking to **connect with alumni, secure corporate opportunities, study abroad, welcome international students, showcase campus life, or build IIT Madras' global brand**, the IAR Student Council provides numerous opportunities to engage with the institute beyond the classroom and beyond the campus.
